name: .264 Cal-121gr Heavy Hammer Hunter®

slowestTwist.raw: Recommended twist rate is 1-9″ or faster

note: The product page also says: "This Hammer Hunter gets the “Heavy” moniker because we designed this bullet to be as heavy as we could make it, and still have a pointed nose, and stabilize in a 1-9″ twist rate. This bullet will be good for the older .264 caliber rifles that commonly have a 1-9″ twist. Runs great out of the .264 Winchester magnum." Recommended use: Big game hunting. The product name says 121 gr; the specification says 122 gr.
